title: A/R Detail: the info icon shows the report's description
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the info icon right of the title.
  2. Move the pointer away.
  3. Press Tab until the info icon has keyboard focus.
  4. Press Escape.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a tooltip shows, word for word: "Each customer’s unpaid invoices, unused credit memos and deposits as of the selected date, grouped by how overdue they are."
  • Step 2: the tooltip closes.
  • Step 3: the same tooltip shows.
  • Step 4: the tooltip closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R1: “Each report has the native report info icon (the one Work In Progress and Technician Utilization use) directly right of its title. Hovering, keyboard focus or a tap shows the report's description in a tooltip; moving away or Escape closes it. The descriptions:”
  • S8-R1, A/R Detail description: “A/R Detail: "Each customer’s unpaid invoices, unused credit memos and deposits as of the selected date, grouped by how overdue they are."”
